_help: News shown in the launcher. Newest first is automatic; "pinned": true keeps one on top. Fields: id, title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), tag (news | update | dev | event), body (markdown: **bold**, `code`, [links](https://...), blank line = new paragraph), image and link (https only). Launchers read this file from GitHub's master branch, so pushing it publishes the post.

news.title: A launcher of our own
news.body:
Super Minecraft Galaxy now opens with its own launcher, on Linux and Windows: news, patch notes, **installations** with their own worlds and settings, and the big green PLAY button.

Make it yours in **Settings**: accent colors, backgrounds (or your own picture), and what the launcher does while you play.

news.title: Super Minecraft Galaxy
news.body: GalaxyCraft has a real name now: **Super Minecraft Galaxy**. Menus, chat and Dolphin all say it. Your worlds carry over as they are.

news.title: Blocks show what they hold
news.body: Signs show their text (colors and glowing text too), banners their patterns, player heads their skins. Shelves and campfires show their items, chest lids open, and Steve raises his shield.
